Red-Eyes Black Chick.evidence: The Reborn pool contains both the current English title Black Dragon's Chick and the legacy/alternate English title Red-Eyes Black Chick. Current Yu-Gi-Oh! Neuron identifies Black Dragon's Chick as passcode 36262024, while legacy card references identify Red-Eyes Black Chick / Red-Eyes B. Chick as alternate English names of that same card/passcode. Treat the two pool labels as one current card identity for rules and the shared 3-copy deck-name limit, while preserving both Reborn source records.

note: Shared identity aliases are exceptional, explicitly reviewed same-card identities. They may reuse an already-mapped engine passcode and must share the deck-name copy-limit group. They are factual identity corrections only, never strategy priors.
